description: This Python test source file contains unit tests for the bitbucket prompt manager component of the litellm project. It tests classes, methods, and behaviors related to BitBucketClient, prompt parsing, rendering, and integration workflows.

classes.name: BitBucketClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with BitBucket repositories, including methods for fetching file content and listing files.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptManager
classes.description: Manages prompts stored in BitBucket, including parsing prompt files, rendering templates, and reloading prompts.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template with associated metadata and content.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_template_creation()
methods.description: Tests creation and attribute assignment of BitBucketPromptTemplate.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_initialization()
methods.description: Tests initialization of BitBucketClient with different authentication methods.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_missing_required_fields()
methods.description: Ensures that missing required fields during BitBucketClient initialization raise appropriate errors.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_get_file_content_success(mock_get)
methods.description: Mocks and tests successful retrieval of file content from BitBucket.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_get_file_content_not_found(mock_get)
methods.description: Mocks and tests behavior when the specified file is not found.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_get_file_content_access_denied(mock_get)
methods.description: Mocks and tests behavior on access denied errors.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_get_file_content_auth_failed(mock_get)
methods.description: Mocks and tests behavior on authentication failure.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_client_list_files_success(mock_get)
methods.description: Mocks and tests successful file listing in a directory.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_parse_prompt_file()
methods.description: Tests parsing of prompt files with YAML frontmatter and content.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_parse_prompt_file_no_frontmatter()
methods.description: Tests parsing of prompt files without YAML frontmatter.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_render_template()
methods.description: Tests rendering a template with variable substitution.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_render_template_not_found()
methods.description: Tests error handling when attempting to render a non-existent template.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_integration(mock_client_class)
methods.description: Mocks and tests the integration workflow: fetching prompt, parsing, and rendering.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_parse_prompt_to_messages()
methods.description: Tests parsing prompt content into structured message objects, including multi-role conversations.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_pre_call_hook()
methods.description: Verifies the pre_call_hook method processes prompt and updates message and parameter list.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_pre_call_hook_no_prompt_id()
methods.description: Tests behavior of pre_call_hook with no prompt_id provided.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_get_available_prompts()
methods.description: Checks retrieval of prompt IDs available in the prompt manager.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_reload_prompts(mock_client_class)
methods.description: Tests reloading prompts from BitBucket and parsing them properly.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_yaml_parsing_fallback()
methods.description: Tests fallback YAML parsing when PyYAML is unavailable.

methods.name: test_bitbucket_prompt_manager_yaml_parsing_with_types()
methods.description: Confirms correct parsing of various data types in YAML content.
